connectors.name: 135AI 排版
connectors.description: Understands your content → matches the style → recommends a template → auto-illustrates and lays out the article — no layout skills needed, no switching between tools.
connectors.description_zh:
一句话，文章自动排好。
理解内容 → 匹配风格 → 推荐模板 → 自动配图排版。
不用学排版，也不用在多个工具之间来回切换。
connectors.description_en: Understands your content → matches the style → recommends a template → auto-illustrates and lays out the article — no layout skills needed, no switching between tools.
examples_zh: 把这篇文章用 135 AI 排版，风格正式简洁，适合政务公众号
帮我把这篇活动推文排得更有设计感，并推荐合适的模板
按 https://xxx.com 这个链接的风格，重新排版我这篇稿子
examples_en: Format this article with 135 AI Layout — formal and clean, suitable for a government-affairs WeChat account.
Give this event post a more polished design and recommend a fitting template.
Restyle my draft to match the look of https://xxx.com

connectors.name: 活页
connectors.description: LivePage turns what your AI makes (daily briefs, weekly reports, industry news, decks, invitations) into a WeChat link and a mini-program card you can share to WeChat groups and Moments. Push a new edition to your WeChat on a schedule at the same link, see who read it, and collect sign-ups on an invitation.
connectors.description_zh: 把 AI 做好的日报、周报、行业动态、演示稿、邀请函发成微信链接和小程序卡片，分享到微信群和朋友圈；每天定时推送到微信，同一链接持续更新，看得到谁看了，邀请函能收报名。
connectors.description_en: LivePage turns what your AI makes (daily briefs, weekly reports, industry news, decks, invitations) into a WeChat link and a mini-program card you can share to WeChat groups and Moments. Push a new edition to your WeChat on a schedule at the same link, see who read it, and collect sign-ups on an invitation.
examples_zh: 根据你对我和我工作的了解，每天早上 8 点帮我整理一份我需要关注的行业动态，用活页推送到我微信
每天收盘后帮我整理一份 A 股复盘，用活页更新同一个链接并推送到我微信
帮我写一份本周工作报告，用活页发成微信链接给同事，明天告诉我谁看了
做一张周六团建聚餐邀请函，用活页分享到微信群，大家点开就能报名
帮我做一份国庆旅行攻略，用活页分享到亲友微信群，大家在微信里就能看
examples_en: Based on what you know about me and my work, put together the industry news I should follow every morning at 8 and push it to my WeChat with LivePage
After the market closes each day, write an A-share recap, update it at the same LivePage link and push it to my WeChat
Write this week's work report, send it to colleagues as a WeChat link with LivePage, and tell me tomorrow who read it
Make an invitation for Saturday's team dinner and share it to the WeChat group with LivePage so people can sign up
Plan a National Day travel guide and share it with LivePage to the family WeChat group so family and friends can read it in WeChat

connectors.name: 3Chat 私域客户运营
connectors.description: Query, filter and manage customers through connected channels in 3Chat such as WeChat, WeCom, RedNote and Douyin, and send personalized messages to individual or bulk targeted customers. After customers reply, the configured 3Chat Agent can follow up on the context, provide 7×24-hour autonomous reception, and continuously complete demand communication, product Q&A, objection handling and purchase guidance, helping merchants turn customer insights into real reach and transaction opportunities.
connectors.description_zh: 通过微信、企业微信、小红书、抖音等3Chat中已连接渠道查询、筛选、运营客户。向单个或批量客户定向发送个性化消息。客户产生回复后，已配置的 3Chat Agent 可接续上下文，提供 7×24 小时自主接待，持续完成需求沟通、产品答疑、异议处理和购买引导，帮助商家将客户洞察转化为真实触达和成交机会。
connectors.description_en: Query, filter and manage customers through connected channels in 3Chat such as WeChat, WeCom, RedNote and Douyin, and send personalized messages to individual or bulk targeted customers. After customers reply, the configured 3Chat Agent can follow up on the context, provide 7×24-hour autonomous reception, and continuously complete demand communication, product Q&A, objection handling and purchase guidance, helping merchants turn customer insights into real reach and transaction opportunities.
examples_zh: 我昨天有哪些新客户？
给林女士拟一条跟进消息。
把这张活动图片和介绍，发给张先生。
examples_en: What new clients did I get yesterday?
Draft a follow-up message for Ms. Lin.
Send this event photo and introduction to Mr. Zhang.

connectors.name: 51社保
connectors.description: Social-insurance and housing-fund contribution bases, ratios, filing deadlines and policy sources across 311 Chinese cities; search original policy texts and analysis reports with supporting links.
connectors.description_zh: 覆盖全国 311 城（含 33 个县级市）的社保、公积金缴费基数与比例，可查经办截止日、最低工资、社平工资与产假天数；检索社保政策原文与政策分析报告，附原文链接。
connectors.description_en: Social-insurance and housing-fund contribution bases, ratios, filing deadlines and policy sources across 311 Chinese cities; search original policy texts and analysis reports with supporting links.
examples_zh: 北京2026年五险一金缴费基数上下限是多少？
深圳非深户医疗二档的公司和个人缴费比例是多少？
上海社保每月最晚什么时候办理？
成都最新的生育产假是多少天？
帮我找广东省关于加班费的政策原文
examples_en: What are Beijing's social insurance contribution limits for 2026?
Show the contribution rates for non-local residents under Shenzhen medical tier 2.
What is Shanghai's monthly social insurance processing deadline?
How many days of maternity leave does Chengdu grant?
Find the original policy text on overtime pay for Guangdong province.

connectors.name: 千图 AI
connectors.description: Search licensed assets, generate images and videos, run editable workflows, and manage creative assets in WorkBuddy.
connectors.description_zh: 在 WorkBuddy 中搜索正版素材、生成图片和视频、运行可编辑工作流，并管理创意资产。
connectors.description_en: Search licensed assets, generate images and videos, run editable workflows, and manage creative assets in WorkBuddy.
examples_zh: 搜索适合秋季营销海报的正版素材，并给出三种创意方向
生成一张 16:9 的科技发布会主视觉，先说明预计积分消耗
读取我的海报工作流，保留原有节点结构并创建一个春日版本
examples_en: Find licensed assets for an autumn marketing poster and suggest three directions.
Generate a 16:9 key visual for a technology launch and explain the expected credit cost first.
Read my poster workflow, preserve its canvas structure, and create a spring version.

connectors.name: 智驾专区审批与工单
connectors.description: Aggregated approval-domain connector: zone onboarding (account whitelisting, bastion hosts, public whitelists, AK/SK, image publishing; submission open, every write needs a two-phase confirmation) plus ticket forensics (enum maps, ticket list, single-ticket detail; read-only). Connects as a remote HTTPS service behind a gateway. Tool names and the current tool face come from the runtime (`tools/list`).
connectors.description_zh: 审批域聚合连接器：专区接入开通（开白 / 堡垒机 / 公网白名单 / AK-SK / 镜像推送，含写操作、两段式确认）+ 工单取证（只读）；工具名与工具面以运行时为准。
connectors.description_en: Aggregated approval-domain connector: zone onboarding (account whitelisting, bastion hosts, public whitelists, AK/SK, image publishing; submission open, every write needs a two-phase confirmation) plus ticket forensics (enum maps, ticket list, single-ticket detail; read-only). Connects as a remote HTTPS service behind a gateway. Tool names and the current tool face come from the runtime (`tools/list`).
examples_zh: 帮客户开通自驾三区白名单
上次那个申请审批到哪了
申请一个跳板机账号
examples_en: Open the self-driving zone 3 whitelist for a customer
Where is that approval request I submitted?
Apply for a bastion host account

connectors.name: 智驾沙箱连接器
connectors.description: The single ADC sandbox connector, built around three job-to-be-done: landing a zone (whitelisting, bastion accounts, public ingress, image push), locating why a training job failed (Pod-by-Pod events and logs, host and TKE evidence), and mining collected and labeled data (job templates and tasks, collect plans, multimodal retrieval), plus approval workflows and ticket forensics. Every write needs a two-phase confirmation and an idempotency key; upstreams that are not configured are not registered.
connectors.description_zh: 智驾沙箱连接器：专区落地（开白、堡垒机、公网白名单、镜像推送）、训练排障（逐 Pod 取证）、数据挖掘（作业任务、采集计划、多模态检索）与工单审批；写操作两段式确认 + 幂等。
connectors.description_en: The single ADC sandbox connector, built around three job-to-be-done: landing a zone (whitelisting, bastion accounts, public ingress, image push), locating why a training job failed (Pod-by-Pod events and logs, host and TKE evidence), and mining collected and labeled data (job templates and tasks, collect plans, multimodal retrieval), plus approval workflows and ticket forensics. Every write needs a two-phase confirmation and an idempotency key; upstreams that are not configured are not registered.
examples_zh: 客户要落地自驾专区：先按三层核一遍还缺什么，再把开白、堡垒机、公网白名单和镜像推送权限一起提上去。
这个训练任务卡在容器启动阶段，逐 Pod 看事件和日志，判断是镜像、配额还是数据挂载的问题。
把上周采集计划里的标注数据跑一遍挖掘，先看结果总览，再用多模态检索把命中的样本拉出来。
examples_en: A customer is landing a self-driving zone: check what is still missing across the three layers, then submit the whitelist, bastion, public-ingress and image-push requests together.
This training job is stuck at container start - inspect events and logs Pod by Pod and tell me whether it is the image, the quota or the data mount.
Run mining over last week's collected and labeled data, show me the results overview first, then pull the matching samples with multimodal retrieval.

connectors.name: AE互联·全网工具,一站搞定
connectors.description: 1400+ Tools, One-Stop Access: AI image & video generation, e-commerce product selection analytics, social media content & sentiment, and stock/financial data — one registration unlocks everything, at prices significantly discounted from official channels. Currently covered:Finance: Access market quotes, stock prices, candlestick charts, trading volumes, corporate financial data, financial reports, and fundamentals for Chinese A-shares and U.S. stocks. Coverage also includes mutual funds, ETFs, foreign exchange, exchange rates, Bitcoin, and other cryptocurrencies, supporting equity and company research, investment analysis, and market monitoring. Integrated financial data providers include Tushare and CoinGecko.Content Generation: Create AI-generated images, generate images from text or reference images, produce product visuals and posters, remove backgrounds, and render text in images. Capabilities also include image-to-video and text-to-video generation, digital avatar presenter videos, voiceovers, background music, and sound effects. The platform brings together ByteDance’s Dreamina (Jimeng), Seedream, and Seedance, alongside Kling, Qwen, Wan, Tencent Hunyuan, MiniMax / Hailuo AI, Zhipu GLM, Google Gemini / Nano Banana / Veo, OpenAI GPT Image / Whisper, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, and other models and tools for image production, video creation, and audio processing.Information Retrieval: Run keyword-based web searches, look up news, conduct industry research and in-depth investigations, and access SEO data, semantic search results, web content extraction, and scraping proxy services. Integrated providers include Perplexity, Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, and Linkup. The platform also supports searches for research papers, academic literature, citation relationships, and patent information; social media content and data queries for X (Twitter), YouTube, and TikTok; and searches for GitHub repositories, code, and developer documentation.E-commerce: Access data related to Douyin, TikTok Shop, Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, Xiaohongshu (RED), Xianyu (Goofish), 1688, Amazon, Shopee, Temu, and other platforms. Services such as Chanmama, Kalodata, and Sorftime provide insights into products, stores, creators, livestreams, and sales performance, supporting product sourcing and selection for domestic and cross-border markets, supplier discovery, market research, and competitor analysis.Other Services: Access mapping and weather services such as Amap and QWeather, with support for place searches, geocoding, and global and local weather queries to assist with travel planning. Additional capabilities include optical character recognition (OCR), document parsing, content extraction from PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files, and searches for film, television, and job-related information(AgentEarth).
connectors.description_zh: 1400+ 工具一站调用：AI 生图生视频、电商选品分析、社媒内容与舆情、股票金融数据，注册一次全打通，价格相对官方大幅折扣。目前已覆盖：金融： 查询 A股、美股股票行情、股价、K线、成交量、公司财务、财报及基本面数据，覆盖基金、ETF、外汇、汇率、比特币和加密货币，辅助股票与公司研究、投资分析和市场跟踪。接入 Tushare、CoinGecko 等金融数据服务。内容生成： 支持 AI 生图、文生图、图生图、商品图、海报、抠图、文字渲染、图生视频、文生视频、数字人口播、配音、背景音乐与音效生成。聚合字节跳动即梦相关模型 Dreamina 即梦、Seedream、Seedance，以及可灵 Kling、通义千问 Qwen、通义万相 Wan、腾讯混元 Hunyuan、MiniMax／海螺 AI、智谱 GLM、Google Gemini／Nano Banana／Veo、OpenAI GPT Image／Whisper、Stable Diffusion、FLUX、HeyGen、ElevenLabs 等模型与工具，满足图片制作、视频创作和音频处理需求。信息检索： 按关键词开展联网搜索、新闻查询、行业调研和深度研究，获取 SEO 数据、语义搜索结果、网页内容提取与爬取代理服务。接入 Perplexity、Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl、Linkup 等；支持论文、学术文献、引用关系与专利信息检索，X（Twitter／推特）、YouTube、TikTok 社媒内容与数据查询，以及 GitHub 仓库、代码和开发文档查询。电商： 获取抖音、TikTok Shop、淘宝、天猫、京东、小红书、咸鱼、1688、亚马逊、Shopee、Temu 等平台相关数据，通过蝉妈妈、Kalodata、Sorftime 等服务查询商品、店铺、达人、直播及带货表现，辅助国内与跨境选品、供应商查找、市场调研和竞品分析。其他： 提供高德地图 Amap、和风天气 QWeather 等地图与天气服务，支持地点查询、地理编码、全球及本地天气查询，辅助出行规划；支持 OCR 图片文字识别、文档解析、PDF／Word／Excel／PPT 内容提取，并提供影视、招聘、法律、企业招标投标招投标 等查询 (AgentEarth)。

使用 AE 查询化妆品品类的达人带货数据、关键词热度和竞品趋势
通过 AE 帮我生成一组适合手机新品发布的图片素材，要简约，具有科技时尚感
examples_en: Use AE to look up Tesla's latest stock price, rating consensus, and target price.
Use AE to retrieve papers, news, and reports on the new energy industry and compile credible conclusions.
Use AE to query influencer-selling data, keyword trends, and competitor trends for the cosmetics category.

connectors.name: Aholo Lux3D MCP
connectors.description: China Lux3D MCP: generate 3D/image assets, check pricing and retrieve task results.
connectors.description_zh: 国内版 Lux3D 连接器：生成 3D 或图片、查询余额与报价，并获取任务结果。
connectors.description_en: China Lux3D MCP: generate 3D/image assets, check pricing and retrieve task results.
examples_zh: 用这张椅子图片生成 3D 模型，先给我报价再执行。
查询我刚才提交的生成任务，并提供模型下载链接。
把这个模型转换成 FBX 格式，先确认费用。
examples_en: Create a 3D model from this chair image; show me the quote before submitting.
Check my submitted generation task and provide the model download link.
Convert this model to FBX after confirming the cost.

connectors.name: AI-HIVE
connectors.description: 100+ top AI models (Seedance 2.5, H3 MiniMax, Wan 3.0, GPT-image, Nano-Banana, Deepseek, Kimi). One config.
connectors.description_zh: 连接全球 100+ 顶尖 AI 模型（Seedance 2.5、H3 (MiniMax)、Wan 3.0、GPT-image、Nano-Banana、Deepseek、Kimi 等），一键搞定文本、图像、视频创作。
connectors.description_en: 100+ top AI models (Seedance 2.5, H3 MiniMax, Wan 3.0, GPT-image, Nano-Banana, Deepseek, Kimi). One config.
examples_zh: 先联网搜一组宋代美学参考（服饰纹样、青绿山水、木构建筑），据此生成一张汉服少女主视觉概念图；再把这张图做成 12 秒电影感运镜视频：0-4s 缓慢推进特写衣纹、4-8s 环绕微距工艺、8-12s 横移拉远见全景，带氛围光与影视级色调，画面流畅稳定、面部五官清晰不变形、无抖动无闪烁。
帮我设计一个日漫风战斗少女 IP：银白长发、异色瞳（左金右蓝）、机甲肩甲、战斗服。先搜同类热门人设找配色参考，再用固定角色锚点『银发异色瞳少女，机甲肩甲，战斗姿态，锐利眼神』原样复用，生成正面/侧面/背面的三视图，统一画风与配色，用于盲盒手办立项。
搜一下今年新茶饮夏季营销主视觉趋势，据此做一张门店开业促销海报：主标题大字『买一送一』、暖橙色调、左侧 40% 留白、电影感侧光、3:4 竖版，适合朋友圈与小红书投放；另出一张极简冷调备选。
做一个柠檬黄泰迪熊盲盒手办系列：先出基础款 Q 版三视图（圆脸大眼、公仔比例），再连续迭代 5 款不同穿搭与配饰的衍生款（宇航员/厨师/旗袍/运动/蒸汽朋克），保持同一角色锚点与盲盒比例，统一柔光陶瓷质感。
搜一组『职场精英写实肖像』布光与构图参考，生成一张商务正装职业照：自然窗光、浅景深、干净灰渐变背景、8K、对称构图，用于简历与领英头像；再生成一张同人物的汉服写真做风格对比。
以『赛博朋克雨夜东京』为主题做一条 20 秒产品概念短片：先搜视觉参考，分三镜——0-7s 俯冲入巷（Aerial Crane Down）、7-14s 环绕产品特写（Orbit）、14-20s 手持跟随走出霓虹（Handheld Tracking）；运镜连续不跳切，原生立体声环境音+Synthwave 124BPM，画面稳定、角色不变形。
examples_en: First search the web for a set of Song-dynasty aesthetic references (costume patterns, green-blue landscape, wooden architecture); from those, generate a hanfu-girl hero concept image. Then turn it into a 12s cinematic camera-move video: 0-4s slow dolly-in on the garment texture, 4-8s orbiting macro of the craftsmanship, 8-12s lateral pan pulling back to full scene, atmospheric light and a filmic grade, smooth and stable, facial features sharp and undeformed, no jitter no flicker.

Design a Japanese-anime battle-girl IP: silver long hair, heterochromia (left gold / right blue), mecha pauldrons, battle outfit. First search similar trending character designs for a color reference, then reuse a fixed character anchor 'silver-haired heterochromia girl, mecha pauldrons, battle stance, sharp gaze' verbatim to generate front / side / back three-view turnarounds with a consistent art style and palette, for a blind-box figure pitch.

Search this year's new-tea-drink summer marketing visual trends, then make a store-opening promo poster: bold headline 'Buy One Get One Free', warm orange palette, 40% left negative space, cinematic side light, 3:4 vertical, fit for WeChat Moments and Xiaohongshu; also output a minimal cool-tone alternate.

Build a lemon-yellow teddy-bear blind-box figure series: first a base Q-version three-view (round face, big eyes, figure proportions), then iteratively derive 5 variants with different outfits and accessories (astronaut / chef / qipao / sporty / steampunk), keeping the same character anchor and blind-box proportions, unified soft ceramic lighting.

Search a set of 'professional elite realistic portrait' lighting and composition references, generate a business-formal ID photo: natural window light, shallow depth of field, clean grey-gradient backdrop, 8K, symmetric framing, for résumé and LinkedIn avatar; then generate a hanfu portrait of the same person as a style contrast.

Make a 20s product concept short themed 'cyberpunk rainy Tokyo': first search visual references, then three shots — 0-7s aerial crane down into the alley, 7-14s orbit macro on the product, 14-20s handheld tracking walking out through neon; continuous camera, no cut jumps, native stereo ambient sound + Synthwave 124 BPM, stable frame, character undeformed.

connectors.name: 深知可信工作台
connectors.description: DKnow Trusted Workbench focuses on trusted knowledge services for laws, policies, and standards, while supporting industry research and public-service scenarios. 请使用深知可信工作台检索：GB/T 35273—2020《信息安全技术 个人信息安全规范》对个人信息保存期限和删除有哪些要求？请列出对应原文条款及权威来源链接。
请使用深知可信工作台研究：2024年以来国家层面支持低空经济发展的主要政策有哪些？请拆解政策目标、重点任务和适用领域，结合多份权威来源交叉验证并追溯原文。
examples_en: Use DKnow Trusted Workbench to find the current eligibility conditions and required documents for housing provident fund rental withdrawal in Shenzhen. Quote the applicable policy text and provide authoritative source links.

Use DKnow Trusted Workbench to identify the requirements on personal-information retention and deletion in GB/T 35273—2020, Information Security Technology — Personal Information Security Specification. Quote the relevant clauses and provide authoritative source links.

Use DKnow Trusted Workbench to research major national policies supporting China's low-altitude economy since 2024. Break the question down by policy objectives, key tasks, and applicable fields, cross-check multiple authoritative sources, and trace the findings to original documents.

connectors.name: 企查查·法律数据
connectors.description: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.
connectors.description_zh: 检索与核验中国法律法规和司法案例。覆盖全量现行法律、行政法规、司法解释——法规级到法条级逐字正文，标注时效性与效力级别；海量裁判文书及 2.5 万+ 权威案例（最高法/最高检指导性案例、公报案例、典型案例）；并对文本中的法条与案号引用逐条回库核验、标注时效、生成可溯源超链。用自然语言完成法条依据查找、类案检索、原文调取与法律引用核验，从源头消除法条与案号幻觉。
connectors.description_en: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.
examples_zh: 员工拒绝调岗被解除劳动合同，有哪些法律依据？请给出法条原文并确认是否现行有效
找几个卖方违约的买卖合同纠纷判决作类案参考
有没有关于个人信息保护的最高法指导性案例？
对方逾期交货三个月，我方能否解除合同并主张违约金？帮我研判一下
核验这段话的引用：「依据《劳动合同法》第二十三条、第二十四条和《民法典》第五百八十五条，竞业限制违约金约定过高的可以请求适当减少」——法条是否真实、是否现行有效，附上溯源链接
examples_en: An employee was dismissed for refusing job reassignment — what are the legal grounds? Give the verbatim statute text and confirm it is currently in force.
Find a few sales-contract dispute judgments where the seller breached, as similar-case references.
Are there any Supreme People's Court guiding cases on personal information protection?
The other party delayed delivery by three months — can we terminate the contract and claim liquidated damages? Give me an assessment.

Verify the citations in this passage: "Under Articles 23 and 24 of the Labor Contract Law and Article 585 of the Civil Code, an excessive non-compete penalty may be reduced upon request." Are these provisions real and currently in force? Include source links.

connectors.name: SCNet图文识别
connectors.description: An all-in-one document intelligence platform powered by Sugon Supercomputing's domestic infrastructure with three core capabilities: (1) High-precision OCR & data extraction — printed/handwritten text, seals, tables, and structured field extraction from invoices, IDs, qualifications, and financial documents; (2) High-fidelity document parsing — reconstructs full-page layouts (TOC, paragraphs, tables, formulas, chemical structures, images, seals) into hierarchical structured Markdown; (3) Document format conversion — PDF-to-Word, image-to-Word, image-to-PPT with high-fidelity layout preservation. Ideal for research, finance, government, legal, and manufacturing.

connectors.name: 鹄得SCRM
connectors.description: Query and manage WeCom business capabilities: customer profiles, tags, customer groups (tags, ownership transfer, exit logs, welcome messages), asset library (browse and official-account article sync), live QR codes, mass messaging (to customers and to group chats), moments, friend-adding tasks, unfriend alerts, chat keyword rules, conversation tag rules (auto-tagging customers when keywords are hit) and a script library. Except for articles, which can be synced in, image/link/video/file/mini-program assets must be created in the Wenear SCRM console; any operation needing an external file, image or asset ID always uses real content supplied by the user and never fabricates it. Follow-up records, opportunities and chat records will follow as the server exposes them.
connectors.description_zh: 查询或管理企业微信中的客户信息、客户标签、客户群（群标签、群继承、退群记录、群欢迎语）、素材库（查询与公众号文章同步）、活码（渠道码/群活码/一键拉群）、群发（好友群发与企微群群发）、朋友圈、加好友任务、删人提醒、聊天关键词规则、会话标签规则（命中关键词自动给客户打标签）、话术库等业务能力。素材中除文章可由同步产生外，图片/链接/视频/文件/小程序均需在鹄得 SCRM 后台创建；需要外部文件、图片或素材 ID 的操作一律使用用户提供的真实内容，不会凭空生成。跟进记录、商机、聊天记录等能力将随服务端开放逐步支持。

Except for articles, which can be synced in, image/link/video/file/mini-program assets must be created in the Wenear SCRM console; any operation needing an external file, image or asset ID always uses real content supplied by the user and never fabricates it. Follow-up records, opportunities and chat records will follow as the server exposes them.

connectors.name: yihook
connectors.description: Generate images, extract products, analyze and enhance videos, create UGC and smart product videos with your Yihook account. Development candidate includes photo avatars and video lip sync with uploaded audio or text-to-speech, with separate voice and video budget confirmation. Development candidate also supports Amazon ad image resizing after copy editing, size selection and cost confirmation. Adapt locally uploaded or linked reference videos for products after reviewing the reference analysis and confirming structure and cost. Create automotive marketing videos with Seedance 2.0 character reference after confirming the full plan and cost. Translate one local video with fast dubbing, fast lip sync or precision lip sync after a free quote and cost confirmation. Extract one highlight clip from a local 3–60 minute video after confirming aspect ratio, captions and cost, then query and download the result. View AI Research period credits and seats, purchase your first plan, separately confirm a social monitoring account, and query overviews, collected posts and post metrics. Product parsing and viral analysis show research-first and general-credit top-up quotes and settlement. Manage cancellations and seat changes on the website. Create one green-screen or livestream host product photo with Yi Image 2.5 Pro from host and product images plus the bundled composition base, after a free estimate and cost confirmation. Create one still-life product photo with Seedream 5.0 Pro after confirming image type, aspect ratio and cost, then deliver the generated image directly. Create one empty-handed host avatar image from a portrait or text with Yi Image 2.5 Pro at 9:16 and 2K, choosing a green screen or category livestream studio and confirming the cost first. Create a full-body fashion try-on from model and garment images. Without a model photo, create a model with Midjourney V8.2 and then dress them with Yi Image 2.5 Pro after confirming the full two-stage cost. Deliver the model at native size and the try-on at 3:4 and 2K with the bundled grey studio background. Design an original e-commerce model, automatically select one of the first four Midjourney V8.2 portraits, and create one 9:16 2K four-panel model card with Yi Image 2.5 Pro after confirming the complete cost. Portraits use native resolution; model-card changes can retain the selected identity.
connectors.description_zh: 通过 yihook 账号生成图片、解析商品、分析爆款视频、增强视频、制作 UGC 与商品智能成片并查询结果。 开发候选支持照片数字人口播与视频口型同步的上传录音与文案配音路线，配音和视频分阶段确认费用。 开发候选支持Amazon广告图片多尺寸适配：识别并编辑文案、选择尺寸、确认费用后生成。 支持本地上传或链接参考视频及商品素材，展示参考分析、确认结构及费用后，批量制作商品克隆与改编视频。 支持 Seedance 2.0 角色参考汽车营销短视频，生成前统一确认完整方案与费用。 支持单条本地视频翻译配音与三种口型处理方式，免费预检并确认费用后执行。 支持本地3—60分钟长视频高光提取，确认画幅、字幕和费用后生成一条主片段并查询下载。 支持查看AI研策周期赠分与席位，首次购买并独立确认绑定社媒监测席位，查询账号概览、已采集作品及单条指标；商品解析和爆款分析展示专用积分优先、通用积分补差的报价与结算；取消和席位变更到网页操作。 支持上传主播与商品图，使用 Yi Image 2.5 Pro 编辑一张绿幕或直播间持品商拍图，含固定构图底图，免费估价并确认费用后制作。 支持上传真实商品照，以 Seedream 5.0 Pro 制作一张白底棚拍、生活场景或品牌氛围静物图，确认比例和真实费用后生成并直接交付。 支持根据人像或文字，以 Yi Image 2.5 Pro 制作一张9:16、2K空手主播形象图；选择绿幕或品类直播间，免费估价并确认费用后生成。 支持用人物图与服饰图制作全身试穿主图；没有人物图时用悠船V8.2创建模特，再用Yi Image 2.5 Pro试穿，先确认两阶段完整费用。人物按实际尺寸、试穿默认3:4及2K，沿用随包浅灰摄影背景。 支持文字定制原创电商模特，悠船V8.2首轮四候选自动选一张，再用Yi Image 2.5 Pro制作一张9:16、2K四宫格模卡，先确认完整费用；人物使用原生分辨率，保留身份的模卡修改单独核价。
